_readme: Seasonal picks for the counter's 'In season' group (Plan 07 section 4.3). The build scores every drink for each Japanese season and stores 5 picks per season in shelf.json; the page chooses the season from the visitor's month. keywords are matched ignoring case against the drink's Name, Style(s), Public Notes and Other Detail Type: a plain word must match a whole word (so 'aki' does not match 'Akita'), a phrase matches as written, and Japanese characters match anywhere. An entry written 'A/B' is two keywords. summerAbvMax: a drink at or under this ABV counts as one summer match. Scoring is +3 per matching keyword (each counted once), +2 favourite, +1 if it has a published label photo, +0.5 if it is among the recentWindow most recent drinks. The top 5 are taken, with at most maxPerCategory from one category. If fewer than 5 match, favourites then recent drinks fill the rest. pins puts drink IDs first for a season, exclude removes drink IDs from every season.
